---
name: Spike
about: Time-boxed investigation to answer a question or reduce uncertainty
labels: spike, draft
---

### Question to answer
<!-- The specific question this spike should resolve. Phrase it so the answer is a yes/no, a choice, or a number. -->

### Context and motivation
<!-- Why this matters now. Which decision depends on the answer? -->

### Time box
<!-- Maximum effort before reporting back, even if the question isn't fully answered. (e.g. 2 days) -->

### Approach
<!-- How you plan to investigate: prototype, benchmark, reading, interviews, etc. -->

### Out of scope
<!-- What this spike will not cover. -->

### Success criteria
<!-- What a useful answer looks like. Define what "done" means. -->

### Outcome
<!-- Filled in when the spike closes. State the answer, a recommendation (proceed, reject, or need more info), and links to findings, code, or follow-up issues. -->
